method: Unmodified standard viewer global Terrarium field; bilinear interpolation at pixel centers in the signed building frame. No flattening. Four-meter sampling oversamples the coarse mixed-source DEM.
attribution: Mapzen/Terrain Tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
limitations: Approximate global viewer terrain; not surveyed urban foundation levels. Vegetation and urban surface returns can affect the field.
reviewDatumBasis: One unchanged standard host terrain sample outside the street facade,local[0,40]. Original grid,PNG and raw tile unchanged. Approximate common datum,not a surveyed threshold or platform.
